question: Can I control what the file is named when users download it, separate from its actual path? What happens if I don't set a custom name?
ground_truth: You can control the downloaded filename using the `filename` property on the `<Download>` component. This optional property allows you to set exactly what the file will be named when users save it locally, regardless of the original asset's name. For example: `<Download filename="CompanyName-API-v2.pdf" url="/assets/openapi-spec.pdf">Download PDF</Download>` will download the file with your branded filename "CompanyName-API-v2.pdf" instead of "openapi-spec.pdf". If you don't provide the `filename` property, the downloaded file will use the same name as the original asset (so `/assets/openapi-spec.pdf` would download as "openapi-spec.pdf"). Using the filename property is ideal for branding, versioning, or providing more descriptive names than your internal file naming scheme.
